item.title: The Chinese «Equity Joint Venture» no longer exists as a corporate form
item.description: Setting up a company with Chinese partners today means applying the Company Law, not joint-venture law. The deciding body has changed, and the minority shareholder's automatic protection is gone.

item.title: Dividends from China: from 1 January 2026 it matters who holds the shares
item.description: The new double tax treaty takes effect in 2026. The reduced 5% rate is reserved to companies, and the foreign tax credit may not be available: holding personally or through a company is not the same thing.

item.title: «Not on the prohibited list» is true, and it is not enough
item.description: There are three gates into the Chinese market, not one. The negative list says whether a foreign investor may enter a sector; it does not say whether the activity needs a licence, and licences do not look at nationality.
